tooltip.essentialcraft5.mru_vision.held_.en: Held or worn on the head: see MRUCUs through walls
tooltip.essentialcraft5.mru_vision.held_.zh: 拿在手里或戴在头上时，能隔墙看见 MRU 聚集体

tooltip.essentialcraft5.mru_vision.held.zh: 拿在手里时，能隔墙看见 MRU 聚集体

tooltip.essentialcraft5.mru_vision.worn.zh: 戴着时，能隔墙看见 MRU 聚集体

tooltip.essentialcraft5.matrix_projectio.en: Right-click to imprint your MRU Matrix on it
tooltip.essentialcraft5.matrix_projectio.zh: 右键：印上你的 MRU 矩阵

tooltip.essentialcraft5.matrix_projectio.en: Owner: hold right-click for 10 seconds to absorb it into your MRU Matrix
tooltip.essentialcraft5.matrix_projectio.zh: 主人按住右键 10 秒，把它吸收进自己的 MRU 矩阵

tooltip.essentialcraft5.matrix_projectio.en: In a gun's lens slot: targets hit can't heal for a while
tooltip.essentialcraft5.matrix_projectio.zh: 装进枪的透镜格：打中的目标一段时间内回不了血

tooltip.essentialcraft5.matrix_projectio.en: In a gun's lens slot: keep hitting a target to freeze it solid
tooltip.essentialcraft5.matrix_projectio.zh: 装进枪的透镜格：连着打中会把目标冻僵

tooltip.essentialcraft5.matrix_projectio.en: In a gun's lens slot: each hit strips one beneficial effect from the target
tooltip.essentialcraft5.matrix_projectio.zh: 装进枪的透镜格：每打中一下，剥掉目标一个增益效果

tooltip.essentialcraft5.matrix_projectio.en: In a gun's lens slot: each hit drains part of the damage back to you as health
tooltip.essentialcraft5.matrix_projectio.zh: 装进枪的透镜格：每打中一下，把一部分伤害吸回来给自己回血

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_projectio.en: Your MRU Matrix twists with new colors!
message.essentialcraft5.matrix_projectio.zh: 你的 MRU 矩阵扭曲出了新的色彩！

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_projectio.en: This projection carries someone else's MRU Matrix
message.essentialcraft5.matrix_projectio.zh: 这块投影印着别人的 MRU 矩阵，你用不了

tooltip.essentialcraft5.mrucu_container..en: Hold right-click at an MRUCU within %s blocks for %s seconds to bottle it; costs %s%% of the MRU it holds
tooltip.essentialcraft5.mrucu_container..zh: 对着 %s 格内的聚集体按住右键 %s 秒收进瓶里，要付它存量 %s%% 的 MRU
装着一团聚集体：%s MRU，平衡值 %s

tooltip.essentialcraft5.mrucu_container..en: Right-click a block to let it out there
Hold right-click at empty air for %s seconds to pour it out for good
tooltip.essentialcraft5.mrucu_container..zh: 对着空处按住右键 %s 秒，把它倒掉（里面的 MRU 散掉，不退）

message.essentialcraft5.mrucu_container..en: No MRUCU within %s blocks in front of you
message.essentialcraft5.mrucu_container..zh: 前面 %s 格内没有聚集体

message.essentialcraft5.mrucu_container..en: The flask already holds an MRUCU; right-click a block to let it out
message.essentialcraft5.mrucu_container..zh: 瓶里已经装着一团了，右键方块先放出来

message.essentialcraft5.mrucu_container..en: You may not move this MRUCU
Bottling this MRUCU costs %s MRU; your MRU storages don't have enough
message.essentialcraft5.mrucu_container..zh: 收这团要 %s MRU，身上的 MRU 储存物品不够
收进了一团 %s MRU 的聚集体

message.essentialcraft5.mrucu_container..en: Let out an MRUCU of %s MRU
message.essentialcraft5.mrucu_container..zh: 放出了一团 %s MRU 的聚集体

message.essentialcraft5.mrucu_container..en: Poured out an MRUCU of %s MRU; it faded away
message.essentialcraft5.mrucu_container..zh: 倒掉了一团 %s MRU 的聚集体，散掉了

message.essentialcraft5.mrucu_container..en: You can't let it out here

tooltip.essentialcraft5.mhs_armor.shield.en: Matrix Buffer: while charged, takes %s of physical and elemental damage off each hit (%s MRU per point)
tooltip.essentialcraft5.mhs_armor.shield.zh: 矩阵缓冲：有电时替你挡下物理和元素伤害的 %s（每点 %s MRU）

tooltip.essentialcraft5.mhs_armor.shield.en: Also blocks its share of MRU discharges from monsters (%s MRU per point)
tooltip.essentialcraft5.mhs_armor.shield.zh: 怪物打来的 MRU 放电也挡它那一份（每点 %s MRU）

tooltip.essentialcraft5.attunement.mhs_a.en: The shield takes more (35% with all four pieces) and each piece holds 4,000 MRU; with all four pieces at stage 1, a blocked hit gives you Haste I for 2 seconds (Afterflow, at most once every 10 seconds)
tooltip.essentialcraft5.attunement.mhs_a.zh: 护盾挡得更多（四件合计 35%），每件存 4000 MRU；四件都到 1 阶时，护盾挡下一下后给你 2 秒急迫 I（余流，10 秒最多一次）

tooltip.essentialcraft5.attunement.mhs_a.en: The shield takes more (45% with all four pieces), each piece holds 8,000 MRU and its MRU Corruption resistance doubles; it also blocks MRU discharges from monsters
tooltip.essentialcraft5.attunement.mhs_a.zh: 护盾挡得更多（四件合计 45%），每件存 8000 MRU，这件的 MRU 腐化抗性翻倍；怪物打来的 MRU 放电也挡
